normalizations: Node shape aliases are normalized separately by MoonBit.
Mermaid entity placeholders are decoded through browser entities; HTML line breaks project to newline text.
CST, canonical whitespace, diagnostics and layout have independent assertions.
Generated and explicit edge IDs use the pinned database policy, including grouped-endpoint ID placement.
Database group-reference vertices project to group identities, not duplicate model nodes.
